w: Opened in 1885, the Imperial was the second hotel ever built on the Adriatic coast, arriving early in Opatija's rise as a seaside resort. Built in the Art Nouveau style, it remains one of the town's grand old hotel facades from that first wave of coastal tourism.
s: Opatija's second grand hotel on the Adriatic, since 1885
_facts: Second hotel built on the Adriatic coast
Built in the Art Nouveau style

w: City streets doubled as a Grand Prix motorcycle circuit from 1931 to 1977, also known as the Preluk or Kvarner Circuit. Its dramatic sweep along the Adriatic coastline earned it the nickname the 'Monaco' of motorcycle racing -- a resort town's seafront turned racetrack.
s: Opatija's seafront streets once hosted Grand Prix racing
_facts: Also called the Preluk or Kvarner Circuit
Nicknamed the 'Monaco' of Grand Prix motorcycle racing for its Adriatic views
